title: Ernst Steinitz: Modern LaTeX Transcriptions and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Steinitz author lane from corpus package 17
description:
Dedicated Ernst Steinitz author record for modern LaTeX transcriptions, English translation drafts, source witnesses, and QA artifacts. Current public readers cover selected work from 1894, 1897, 1899, 1901, 1910, and 1911, with source-only slices for the 1905 one-sided-polyhedron paper and the 1912 Rectangular Systems II paper included as next-pass material.

Status at a glance. The 1894 dissertation material is now complete in paired German and English working readers. The 1897, 1899, 1901, 1910, and 1911 readers remain delivered as paired German and English working files. The 1905 polyhedron item and 1912 Rectangular Systems II item are source-only in this release. The ZIP artifact preserves TeX, TXT, source scans/source PDFs, render checks, checksums, and package notes.

Latest update. Promotes corpus package 17: completes the 1894 dissertation, replaces the reader guide/status PDF, adds the 1912 Rectangular Systems II source slice, and refreshes the source/witness ZIP.
notes: Corpus package 17 completes the 1894 dissertation in German and English working readers, adds the 1912 Rectangular Systems II source slice as source-only next-pass material, and refreshes the reader guide/status PDF and source/witness ZIP.
